en: Character pack downloads and preview images now work after installing or updating the theme: the installer had left out tools/pack.ps1, so clicking a pack card did nothing and previews stayed blank.

Character pack preview images now appear as soon as they finish downloading, failed downloads report an error on the card instead of failing silently, and hovering an uninstalled pack card shows its preview and material source on the right.
zh: 角色包的下载和预览图在安装或更新主题后现在可以正常工作：安装脚本之前漏复制了 tools/pack.ps1，导致点击角色包卡片没有反应、预览图也无法加载。
角色包预览图下载完成后现在会自动刷新显示，下载启动失败时卡片会显示失败提示而不再静默无反应，鼠标悬停在未安装的角色包卡片上时右侧会显示预览图与素材来源。
